faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED
faq.q1: Are your katanas battle-ready or just for display?
faq.a1: We offer both functional and display-grade katanas. Our battle-ready models are fully sharpened and heat-treated for cutting practice, while our display replicas are designed for cosplay and collection. Each product page clearly indicates the sword's intended use.
faq.q2: What steel types do you use for your blades?
faq.a2: We use a variety of premium steels including T10 tool steel, 1095 high-carbon steel, and traditionally folded steel (Damascus pattern). Our master smiths also offer clay-tempered blades with authentic hamon lines.
faq.a3: Yes, we ship worldwide. All international orders are fully insured and tracked. Please note that some countries have specific regulations regarding sword imports.
faq.q4: How long does it take to receive my order?
faq.a4: In-stock items typically ship within 2-3 business days. Custom and hand-forged orders require 7-14 business days for production. International shipping generally takes 7-21 business days.
faq.a5: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all unused items in original packaging. For defective or damaged items, we provide full refunds or replacements at no additional cost.
faq.q6: Do the swords come with a certificate of authenticity?
faq.a6: Yes, every sword comes with a Certificate of Authenticity that includes detailed specifications, the smith's signature, production date, and a unique serial number.

about.title: About Us
about.storyP1: WOLFKATANA was founded by a group of sword enthusiasts and master smiths who share a deep passion for the ancient art of Japanese swordsmithing. What began as a small workshop in Osaka has grown into a global destination for collectors seeking authentic, hand-forged katanas.
about.storyP2: Every blade that leaves our forge carries with it centuries of tradition, meticulous craftsmanship, and the uncompromising standards of our master artisans.
about.missionP1: We are dedicated to preserving and sharing the timeless art of Japanese sword making. Our mission is to connect collectors worldwide with authentic, masterfully crafted blades while honoring the traditions that have been passed down through generations.
about.craftP1: Each WOLFKATANA blade is individually hand-forged by skilled artisans using traditional techniques. From selecting premium steel to the final polish, every step is performed with precision and reverence for the craft.
about.globalP1: With fulfillment centers in Japan and the United States, we proudly serve collectors in over 60 countries. Our global shipping network ensures that your blade arrives safely, no matter where you are.

faqPage.q1: Do you ship to my country?

faqPage.a2: In-stock items ship within 2-3 business days. International delivery typically takes 7-21 business days depending on your location and customs processing.

faqPage.q7: How do I maintain my katana?
faqPage.a7: Regular maintenance includes cleaning the blade with a soft cloth, applying choji oil to prevent rust, and storing in a dry environment. A maintenance kit is included with every order.
faqPage.a8: All blades come with a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects. This covers structural issues but not damage from misuse, accidents, or normal wear.

craftsmen.title: Our Craftsmen
craftsmen.masterSmithsDesc: Our swords are forged by master artisans with decades of experience. Each smith has trained extensively in traditional Japanese sword-making techniques, ensuring every blade meets the highest standards of quality and authenticity.
craftsmen.processDesc: Creating a katana is a labor of love that requires patience, skill, and dedication. Our process follows centuries-old traditions:
craftsmen.smeltingDesc: We begin with premium raw steel, carefully selected for its purity and carbon content. The steel is heated in a traditional forge until it reaches the perfect temperature for forging.
craftsmen.foldingDesc: The steel is folded multiple times to remove impurities and create the distinctive grain pattern (hada) that is characteristic of high-quality Japanese swords.
craftsmen.shapingDesc: Our smiths carefully shape the blade using hammers and anvils, creating the precise curvature (sori) and profile that define a katana's unique character.
craftsmen.temperingDesc: Clay is applied to the blade before heating and quenching, creating the differential hardness that produces the beautiful hamon line and a razor-sharp edge.
craftsmen.polishingDesc: Master polishers use specialized stones to bring out the blade's beauty, revealing the intricate grain patterns and hamon while achieving a mirror-like finish.
craftsmen.mountingDesc: The blade is fitted with a hand-wrapped handle (tsuka), genuine ray skin, silk ito, and custom fittings (tsuba, fuchi, kashira) to complete the sword.
craftsmen.replicaDesc: Our replica swords are crafted with the same attention to detail as our traditional katanas. We work closely with designers to ensure every replica captures the essence of the original while maintaining functional quality.
craftsmen.qualityDesc: Every sword undergoes rigorous inspection before leaving our workshop. We check for structural integrity, edge sharpness, aesthetic quality, and proper fit of all components. Only blades that meet our exacting standards receive the WOLFKATANA seal of approval.
